reviews.boundary_analysis: Selected-provider boundary includes local dotnet-ef for CLI use and exact scaffold/registration requirements. Provider replacement must satisfy every slot contract item or report Blocked, not drop migration/seeding. Both implementation choices and replacement constraints already registered.

Explicit validator DI integration and ban on legacy auto-validation packages supplement standard FluentValidation; application ILogger remains despite provider-specific edge APIs. Union records each; owning-layer/no-duplication issues reviewed under API/ARC.

Mapster includes its DI package, is volume-gated and cannot enter Domain. Resilience needs actual operation/failure semantics and uses Microsoft APIs without mandating the standard handler. Specific clauses are covered, not entailed merely by approved-package listing.

Decided interactive Swashbuckle baseline expressly excludes built-in raw OpenAPI as fulfillment; Api owns configuration and HTTPS launch URLs cannot target HTTP-only ports. Deployment-justified exposure remains conditional. Already registered.

Named test packages, prior recorded reference edges, Testing isolation and fidelity-gated Testcontainers supplement NUnit. Required slot replacement preserves neutral standards and skill name; optional Domain/Infrastructure test projects need nontrivial behavior. Union covers these independent conditions.

Current CLI selects compatible Angular/TypeScript/RxJS and new-project Vitest; accepted zoneless mode is version-conditioned. Do not force obsolete CLI layouts. Optional slot has prescribed workspace/cardinality and immutable neutral standards; all already represented. Generated-client maintenance is revisited under WF-016.

Not-by-default libraries still warn for concrete-need selections with no executable suppression, already BF-0133. Chosen Material must be used consistently without gratuitous wrappers; repair cannot add state/HTTP libraries to bypass an issue. These constraints are distinct but prior-covered.

Conditional E2E defaults to a small set of important workflows unless broader coverage is required. Fixed workspace e2e location, colocation of other frontend tests and never placing them under backend are registered; not newly inferred from Playwright approval.

Versioning adoption is Reserved; only afterwards install named Controller MVC plus ApiExplorer integration. Approval, timing and named package integration already registered separately from versioning behavior.

Docker only for actual deployment/project need; code layer isolation, reproducible external config, useful Compose services, Node-built frontend with selected hosting rather than mandatory web-server image are all registered leaf obligations. CI image creation also depends on actual deployment.
